text:
Maia: Quick sync — we need a compact spec for model handoff SLA + rollback schema for catalog onboarding. Customer asked for 99.9% uptime and a clear rollback contract. Can we draft something lightweight today?
Samir: +1. We should bind SLA to per-route latency + error rate. e.g., error_rate > 1% over 5m => canary hold / rollback.
Eli: Also include an automated quality check: if core-eval regression > threshold during canary, trigger hold. Define metric names and thresholds.
Juniper: From support: customers want opt-in notifications (email/webhook) and a short grace-run for pinned customers so we don't auto-rollback them without human review.
Lina: Contract side: pinned customers usually need a 14-day migration gracepath, or we honor a pinned SLA exception. Add that to schema.
Samir: We have canary infra but no standardized schema for decisions. Proposal (minimal):
```yaml
name: catalog_handoff_policy_v1
canary_window_sec: 1800  # 30m
failure_rate_threshold_pct: 1.0
latency_p50_threshold_ms: 400
auto_regression_metric: embedding_similarity_delta
regression_threshold: 0.03  # absolute drop
pinned_customer_grace_days: 14
auto_rollback: false  # default: require manual rollback for pinned
notify: ["#catalog-ops", "customer-notify-webhook"]
customer_opt_in_notifications: true
```
Samir: That covers infra triggers. We should make the regression metric pluggable (BLEU / ROUGE / embedding) depending on model type.
Eli: Agree. For embeddings we should use mean cosine drop on eval set + outlier check. Suggest default regression_threshold 0.03 and max_allowed_outliers 2.
Juniper: For support workflow: when canary hold fires, create a "handoff incident" in our tracker with labels: catalog, model-X, canary-hold. Also auto-post a short summary to the customer if opt-in.
Lina: Legal asks that we record the timestamp of the canary decision and the name of the person who approved manual rollback. Add fields for audit: decision_ts, approver_id.
Samir: Updated minimal schema suggestion with audit fields:
```yaml
audit: true
decision_ts: null
approver_id: null
```
DeployBot: canary-deploy model-catalog/model-omega v2 -> canary started (30m window) :rocket:
Maia: Perfect — I'll convert this chat into a short PR for the catalog runbook with the YAML snippet and an example flow chart. Assigning @Samir to implement the schema in canary service and @Eli to add default eval hooks.
Samir: I'll file the infra task after the PR. ETA: EOW for schema + tests.
Eli: I'll scope eval hooks and a small eval-suite for embeddings/text. Need sample prompts from product.
Maia: Thanks — Juniper / Lina, please flag any customer constraints we should bake in before I open the PR. :thumbsup:
